units.source_text: 三公主身体素来羸弱，初次做产，全无经验，觉得非常可怕。

en.t: The Third Princess had always been frail, and with no experience of childbirth, she found her first delivery terribly frightening.

units.source_text: 她汤药也不吃，只是痛感自己命苦，以致遭此不幸之事。

en.t: She would not even take her medicine, but only felt bitterly that her fate was cruel and had brought her to this misery.

units.source_text: 她想：“没奈何了，不如乘此机会，一死了事。”

en.t: She thought, “There is nothing to be done. I may as well take this chance to die and be done with it.”

units.source_text: 源氏在人前掩饰得很好看，但又全然无意进去看看这讨厌的新生儿。

en.t: Genji kept up appearances very well before others, but he had no desire at all to go in and look at the unwelcome newborn child.

units.source_text: 几个年长的侍女私下议论：“啊呀，真是太冷淡了！

en.t: Several older gentlewomen talked privately among themselves, saying, “Oh, how terribly cold he is!

units.source_text: 难得生个儿子，又长得如此端正可爱……”

en.t: After all, she has given birth to a son, and he is so handsome and dear...”

units.source_text: 她们都可怜这婴儿。

en.t: They all felt sorry for the baby.

units.source_text: 三公主偶然听到这些话，想道：“可想而知的了，日后越来越冷淡呢！”

en.t: The Third Princess happened to hear these words and thought, “It is just as I expected. He will only grow colder toward me from now on!”

units.source_text: 她满腹怨恨，又自伤命苦，思量索性出家为尼吧。

en.t: Filled with resentment and pitying her own unhappy fate, she considered simply becoming a nun.

units.source_text: 源氏晚上不回来宿夜，只是白天匆匆一到。

en.t: Genji did not return to spend the night, but only came hurriedly during the day.

units.source_text: 有一天他对三公主说：“我看了人世无常之态，自觉余命已经甚短。

en.t: One day he said to the Third Princess, “Seeing how impermanent this world is, I feel that little time remains to me.

units.source_text: 由于心绪不宁，近来每日勤修佛法。

en.t: Because my mind is troubled, I have lately been devoting myself every day to Buddhist practice.

units.source_text: 此地如此乱杂，妨碍学道之心，所以我不常来。

en.t: This place is so noisy and disordered that it hinders my resolve to follow the Way, so I do not come often.

units.source_text: 你近来如何？

en.t: How have you been lately?

units.source_text: 心情快适了么？

en.t: Has your mood become any easier?

units.source_text: 我很挂念呢。”

en.t: I have been very worried about you.”

units.source_text: 便从帷屏边上向三公主探望。

en.t: Then he looked in on the Third Princess from beside the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 三公主抬起头来答道：“总是活不下去了。

en.t: The Third Princess raised her head and answered, “I cannot go on living.

units.source_text: 生产而死，罪孽深重。

en.t: To die in childbirth would be a grave sin.

units.source_text: 不如让我出家为尼，或可仗此功德而保全性命。

en.t: It would be better to let me become a nun; through that merit, perhaps my life might be preserved.

units.source_text: 即使死了，或可因此消除罪障也。”

en.t: And even if I die, perhaps my sins may thereby be cleansed.”

units.source_text: 她的语气与往常不同，很像个大人了。

en.t: Her tone was unlike her usual one, and she seemed quite grown-up.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“哪有这等事！

en.t: Genji said, “What nonsense!

units.source_text: 莫说不祥的话！

en.t: Do not say such ominous things!

units.source_text: 你为什么起这种念头呢？

en.t: Why have you begun thinking this way?

units.source_text: 生育一事，固然危险可怕，然而决不是一定绝望的！”

en.t: Childbirth is certainly dangerous and frightening, but it is by no means hopeless!”

units.source_text: 但他心中想道：“如果她真有决心而说这话，索性成全了她，却也是好。

en.t: But in his heart he thought, “If she truly says this with firm resolve, it might be best simply to grant her wish.

units.source_text: 近来虽然和她相处，但是处处感觉不快，不胜其苦。

en.t: Lately, even when I am with her, everything feels unpleasant, and the pain is more than I can bear.

units.source_text: 要我回心转意，则又不能。

en.t: Yet I cannot make myself change my heart.

units.source_text: 心中常觉懊恼，态度自然不免冷淡，别人看了也会怪我，实在使我十分痛心。

en.t: I am always vexed at heart, so my manner naturally becomes cold; others will blame me when they see it, and that pains me deeply.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻知了，还要一味怨我怠慢呢。

en.t: If Suzaku-in hears of it, he will only reproach me for neglecting her.

units.source_text: 倒不如借她生病为由，让她出家吧。”

en.t: Perhaps it would be better to use her illness as the reason and let her take the vows.”

units.source_text: 虽然这样想，但又觉怪可怜的。

en.t: Though he thought this, he also felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 年纪轻轻的，那一头青丝细发如此可爱，剪落了实甚可惜！

en.t: She was still so young, and that fine black hair of hers was so lovely; it would be a terrible pity to cut it off.

units.source_text: 便又对她说道：“你还得宽宽心，没有什么大不了的。

en.t: So he said to her again, “You must try to ease your mind. It is nothing so serious.

units.source_text: 看似没救了的人，也会平复起来，最近就有实例。

en.t: Even people who seem beyond saving may recover; there has been such a case recently.

units.source_text: 人世不是那么虚幻无常的。”

en.t: The world is not so fleeting and uncertain as all that.”

units.source_text: 就给她吃汤药。

en.t: Then he gave her the medicine to drink.

units.source_text: 三公主脸色青白，身体十分消瘦，奄奄一息地躺着，但样子异常端详优美。

en.t: The Third Princess lay there deathly pale and terribly thin, barely breathing, yet her appearance was extraordinarily calm and beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏看了，想道：“看到这模样，即使她犯了莫大的罪过，也只得软了心肠，饶恕她了。”

en.t: Seeing her, Genji thought, “Looking at her like this, even if she had committed some enormous sin, one could only soften one’s heart and forgive her.”
